What it is: Swarm auto-hibernates to concierge-banked when fully drained (mandatory closing pass) and auto-relaunches when new work arrives
What it solves: This is slice 1 of the dynamic-per-ticket-agent-routing epic
(.swarmforge/operator/INTAKE-dynamic-per-ticket-agent-routing.md). The epic's
end state is a demand-routed swarm (only a ticket's needed roles run); THIS
slice is narrower — it only automates the whole-swarm park/relaunch transition
that …
How it works: The closing pass hibernates the swarm only when no promotable backlog work remains AND every role in the current roster is idle (empty inbox, no in-process task)
